data.name: 海洋時代-Ocean Age
data.description_full:
《海洋時代-Ocean Age》是一款聚焦15至18世紀地理大發現背景的全球海洋SLG手遊，專為喜愛航海冒險、策略對戰的玩家打造，核心亮點是無強制肝度、資源獲取輕鬆、公平競技無氪金壓力，支持港口貿易與寶藏探索，融合全球航行、迷霧探索、海戰交鋒、自動貿易等多元核心玩法，主打4X航海SLG與航海征服體驗，讓玩家沉浸式感受大航海時代的熱血與魅力，解鎖專屬航海傳奇。
【全球航行·迷霧探索】
遊戲擁有開放式全球地圖，覆蓋30國及300餘座港口，完美還原大航海時代風貌，支持港口經營。玩家可自由航行、探索迷霧寶藏，定期開放跨服競技，全程無閒置，每一次航行都有新收穫與挑戰。

【海戰交鋒·策略對決】
海戰是核心玩法，玩家可組建三線艦隊，搭配傳奇裝備與航海家技能調整戰術，主打航海征服體驗。遊戲內置20餘種歷史船隻、分13個等級，適配各類戰鬥場景，新手無操作門檻，輕鬆上手爭奪海洋霸權。

【傳奇航海家·技能傳承】
70+張金卡航海家分四大職業（海盜，海軍，賞金獵人，探險家），彙聚血腥瑪麗、哥倫布等知名人物。支持覺醒突破與技能繼承，閒置卡片可轉化戰力，為主力航海家定制專屬技能，培養輕鬆無壓力。

【貿易自由·碼頭築城】
遊戲擁有完善貿易體系，涵蓋30大品類、500餘種商品及貴金屬，支持AI命令艦隊自動貿易，無需手動操作即可低買高賣積累財富。玩家可自建碼頭、加入商會，協作爭奪資源，書寫航海傳奇。

【商會共贏·海洋霸權】
加入或創建商會可領取分紅、參與商會戰，貢獻突出可主導海域、指揮海戰。商會戰以資源島、城市爭奪為核心，考驗團隊協作，獲勝可獲稀有道具，助力提升戰力、爭奪海洋霸權。

data.name: 解憂小食光：萌系店員養成 & 餐廳模擬經營
data.description_full:
想擁有一間專屬的森林小店嗎？從招募獲得第一位獸耳店員開始，你將與他們一起研發菜單、自由裝潢、傾聽每位顧客藏在美食背後的故事。沒有催促與壓力，只有慢慢的忙碌、小小的成就，和那些不經意就被治癒的瞬間。在《解憂小食光》裡，展開一場悠閒自在的療癒經營之旅。

◆ 招募各族店員，養成最佳夥伴
招募不同種族的夥伴，每位店員都有獨特技能加成與能力傾向。招募店員並依據能力管理，把對的人放對位置，經營效率顯著提升。養成系統包含等級、星級、屬性、技能等多條成長線，收集店員圖鑑，解鎖人物小傳，逐步擴大商業版圖，讓小店從一人經營發展到溫暖家園。輕鬆當老闆，享受休閒又療癒的養成樂趣。

◆ 傾聽顧客故事，解鎖暖心劇情
每位上門的客人都有屬於自己的回憶與秘密。透過對話與專屬任務，幫助他們找回「記憶碎片」，解鎖豐富的故事線與人物小傳。隨著好感度逐步提升，特殊顧客會成為常客，帶來更穩定的收入。經營的不只是小店，更是人與人之間的溫暖連結。在休閒之餘，體驗沉浸式的暖心劇情。

◆ 研發多樣菜譜，親手創造美味
從榛果司康、海嶼小麵到奶油杯麵，超多創意料理等你解鎖，涵蓋飲品、烘焙、甜品、輕食等豐富品類。簡單卻有挑戰的反應類小玩法「抓時機點擊」，在指針轉盤上按順序精準投入食材，順序錯誤就失敗，解壓又療癒，讓每一道菜都充滿親手製作的成就感。

◆ 自由裝潢改造，隨心打造家園
桌椅、壁紙、地毯、擺飾…所有家具都透過隨機合成獲得，每次合成都像開盲盒一樣充滿驚喜！你可以自由規劃佈置，搭配古典雅緻、簡約時尚、浪漫童話、田園鄉村等不同主題，打造獨一無二的森系小店。從室內裝潢到花園種植收集鮮花，每個角落都由你決定。

◆ 穿搭百變風格，展現個性魅力
店員不只是幫手，還能換裝搭配當季流行服飾。甜美、幹練、華麗、簡約…各種風格隨心切換。收集限定時裝，提升店鋪魅力值，吸引更多客人上門。解鎖每一位店員的人物小傳，與店員互動培養親密度，讓每一次換裝都充滿樂趣與成就感。

【推薦給這樣的你】
喜歡療癒畫風、溫馨日常、慢節奏放鬆的你
喜歡餐廳／咖啡館／美食題材的模擬經營玩家
喜歡萌系角色、店員收集與養成、換裝搭配的你
喜歡自由裝潢佈置、打造專屬空間風格的裝修控
想在休閒裡體驗爆單忙碌感，或想衝榜找目標的你
喜歡放置掛機、離線收益、享受美食帶來幸福感的人

※遊戲內容與活動規則請以實際版本為準。

data.name: Last Age: Survival
data.description_full:
The zombies are running wild in the looming apocalypse, and your previous life has turned to ashes. As a survivor, your mission is not only to survive, but also to build a sturdy fort to protect the future for you and your friends.

Go deep into the desolate world to search for valuable resources. Each survivor has unique skills to help your fortress develop quickly and be unbreakable.

• Fortress Construction

Construct a strong defense shelter and upgrade the walls and tower to withstand the always-evolving zombie threats. You can transform your shelter into a doomsday haven by using technology and weapons systems.

• Resource Gathering and Exploration

Dispatch teams to explore the dangerous wastelands in search of food, materials, and rare equipment. The hidden treasures and sudden emergencies will test your strategy and courage.

• Team Management and Combat

Recruit heroes, make weapons, and research technology to form the strongest combat team. Confront the zombies and powerful mutants. How you strategically match and lay out the formations will determine life or death.

• Unite and Conquer

Team up with other survivors to form alliances and resist the zombie threat together. Capture the resource strongholds and challenge the most extreme enemies to rebuild human civilization from the ruins.

Last Age: Survival is a free-to-play game. Some in-game items (including random items) can be purchased.

Can you build an indestructible fortress to protect the survivors and lead humanity's rebirth in this dangerous apocalypse? Join Last Age: Survival now to take on the ultimate test of survival!

data.name: Merge Valley: Farm Tycoon

Welcome to Merge Valley: Farm Tycoon!
A relaxing yet strategic merge farm game where your dream of building the ultimate farming empire begins! If you love merge games, farm simulation, and casual tycoon experiences, this is the perfect blend of creativity, strategy, and satisfying progression.

Step into a charming valley where every merge brings you closer to becoming the top farm tycoon. Start with a small piece of land and transform it into a thriving farm ville filled with crops, monster workers, and upgraded buildings. Your farming dream starts here!

🌾 Merge, Plant, and Harvest Your Way to Success
In Merge Valley: Farm Tycoon, the core gameplay revolves around merge mechanics that are simple to learn but deeply rewarding to master.
Use generators to produce seeds, then merge seeds to create higher-level crops. The higher the level, the better the rewards! Once your crops are ready, plant them in your farm field and watch your valley come alive. When it’s time to harvest, collect valuable produce and prepare them for sale.
But farming isn’t just about plants — tools matter too! Merge farming tools like hoes to increase their level and efficiency. A stronger tool means faster farming and bigger harvest rewards. Strategic merging is the key to maximizing your farm’s productivity.

👾 Adorable Monster Workers
What makes this merge farm game truly unique? Meet your adorable Monster Workers!
These pixel-style monsters, sometimes called Pixelmon, act as loyal workers who help farmers grow crops and harvest efficiently. Each monster adds charm and personality to your farm valley. They automatically assist with farming tasks, making your progress smoother and more exciting.
Collect, manage, and utilize your monster team to optimize your farm workflow. The better your strategy, the faster your journey to becoming a true farm tycoon.

🏡 Build and Expand Your Dream Farm

Selling crops to the merchant earns coins, and coins mean expansion! Upgrade farm buildings, unlock new land areas, and develop your valley into a booming farming empire.
As your farm grows, so do your opportunities:
- Unlock new crop types
- Discover better generators
- Upgrade tools to higher levels
- Expand buildings for increased production
- Turn your small land into a thriving dream valley

Every upgrade brings you closer to building the ultimate farm tycoon business.

✨ Relaxing Yet Strategic Merge Gameplay

Merge Valley: Farm Tycoon combines relaxing farm simulation with fun merge puzzle elements. Whether you enjoy casual games or more goal-driven farming games, this title offers the perfect balance.

Why players love it:
- Fun and satisfying merge gameplay
- Charming farm theme with colorful visuals
- Monster workers that bring magic and life to your valley
- Continuous progression and rewarding harvest cycles
- Easy to play, challenging to master

Plan your merges carefully. Combine the right items, manage your farm space efficiently, and time your harvest for maximum profit. Smart farmers always think ahead!

🌻 Become the Ultimate Farm Tycoon

This isn’t just another merge game — it’s your opportunity to build a farming empire from scratch. Experience the joy of growing crops, managing resources, upgrading tools, and expanding your valley into a prosperous agricultural kingdom.
If you love merge games, farm games, farming simulation, idle tycoon experiences, and relaxing casual games, Merge Valley: Farm Tycoon delivers everything in one magical farming adventure.
Start small. Merge smart. Harvest big.

Download today and build your dream farm, manage your monster workers, and rise as the ultimate Farm Tycoon in Merge Valley! 🌾✨

data.name: Chỉ Huy Tối Thượng
data.description_full:
Chỉ Huy Tối Thượng
Chỉ Huy Tối Thượng là một trò chơi chiến lược quân sự trực tuyến độc đáo. Trò chơi mới này kết hợp chiến thuật quân sự, lối chơi casual và yếu tố mô phỏng, mang đến trải nghiệm hoàn toàn miễn phí và đầy kịch tính cho người hâm mộ game chiến tranh, RTS (Chiến lược thời gian thực) và chiến đấu quân sự.

Xây dựng Căn cứ
Trải nghiệm tính chân thực của chiến tranh hiện đại bằng cách xây dựng và nâng cấp các công sự quân sự, bao gồm tháp pháo phòng không, kho nhiên liệu và nhà máy thiết giáp. Tạo nên một pháo đài thép bất khả xâm phạm với sự cân bằng hoàn hảo giữa tấn công và phòng thủ. Quản lý chuỗi tài nguyên một cách chiến lược để tối đa hóa năng lực sản xuất chiến tranh, đảm bảo căn cứ của bạn sống sót sau những đợt pháo kích dữ dội trong các trận chiến thời gian thực.

Những Đội quân Huyền thoại
Chiêu mộ các vị tướng Thế chiến II huyền thoại như Eisenhower, Patton, Rommel và Zhukov, mỗi người sở hữu kỹ năng chiến thuật độc đáo và lộ trình nâng cấp cá nhân hóa. Kết hợp nhiều đơn vị quân đội - bộ binh, xe tăng, pháo binh và không quân - để tạo thành đội quân tối thượng có khả năng thống trị chiến trường trong cả chiến dịch PvP và PvE.

Chiến lược Chiến thuật
Một chỉ huy thực thụ giành chiến thắng với tổn thất tối thiểu. Những lựa chọn của bạn - lộ trình tấn công, thứ tự triển khai đơn vị và sử dụng kỹ năng chiến thuật thời gian thực - ảnh hưởng trực tiếp đến kết quả trận chiến. Làm chủ chiến lược chiến trường, tham gia chiến đấu RTS căng thẳng và giành hết chiến thắng này đến chiến thắng khác trong cuộc chiến hành động nhịp độ nhanh.

Chiến tranh Liên minh
Bạn sẽ chọn chiến tranh hay hòa bình? Thành lập hoặc gia nhập một quân đoàn, mở rộng lãnh thổ và tham gia những trận chiến nhiều người chơi quy mô lớn toàn cầu. Phối hợp với đồng minh, nghiền nát căn cứ kẻ thù và chứng tỏ sự thống trị của bạn trong cuộc chiến chiến lược quân sự toàn cầu. Xây dựng liên minh, Đè bẹp áp bức!

Hình ảnh
Đồ họa tuyệt đẹp, được chăm chút tỉ mỉ, từ anh hùng, vũ khí cho đến phương tiện và trang bị. Mọi chi tiết đều tỏa sáng với màu sắc sống động và hiệu ứng ngoạn mục, khiến đây trở thành một trong những game chiến lược chiến tranh được thiết kế đẹp nhất thế giới.

data.name: アヤカシ代行
data.description_full:
「アヤカシ」と共に、人々の依頼を解決せよ――

現代東京を舞台に描かれる、都市非日常RPG『アヤカシ代行』。

繁華都市に潜む怪異事件。掲示板に書き込まれる不可解な謎。
そして、人知れず街を守る“アヤカシ”たち――。

あなたは「代行部」の一員として、個性豊かな“アヤカシ”たちと共に、
街で起きる怪異事件の調査と解決に手伝うことに。

不思議で賑やかな毎日の中で、
彼らと絆を深めていきましょう。

メインストーリーを豪華声優陣によるフルボイスでお届け！
Live2Dで生き生きと動くキャラクターたちが、
あなたをこの少し不思議な世界へ導きます。

■ストーリー
現代の東京――混乱と絶望に満ちた事件が次々と発生し、人々の心
には不安が広がっていた……。

そんな中、「∞ch」で広く知られる大手インターネット企業「森羅万象」
が動き出す。

新たに理事長に就任した青天目嵐牙は、社内に神秘の組織「代行部」
を設立した。

掲示板に書き込まれる怪しい事件の数々を解決する、特別な存在――。
だが、その正体は――彼らはすべて、“アヤカシ”である。

都市の秩序を守るため、正体不明の穢（けがれ）を排除するのを使命に、
彼らは今日も街の闇を駆ける。

あなたも「代行者」の一人として迎えられ、
そんなアヤカシたちと共に、どこかあたたかい日々を過ごしていく。

色々な事件の先で待っているのは、
誰かの孤独や、言葉にできなかった想いかもしれない。

これは、
人とアヤカシが紡ぐ、
優しくて少し不思議な物語。

■アプリ概要
本作は現代東京を舞台に、
個性豊かなアヤカシたちと怪異事件を解決していく都市非日常カードRPGです！

Live2Dで描かれる魅力的なキャラクターたちや、
不思議な都市マップ、
戦略性のあるカードバトルを楽しめます！

⸻

【POINT 1】豪華フルボイスで描かれるメインストーリー！

メインストーリーは豪華声優陣によるフルボイスで展開！

アヤカシたちとの交流を通して、
彼らが抱える悩みや過去、
そして隠された想いに触れていきます。

笑って、悩んで、
時には胸が熱くなる――。

個性豊かな仲間たちとの物語を、
ぜひお楽しみください！

⸻

【POINT 2】Live2Dで楽しむ、あたたかくて、ちょっとドキドキする日常！

data.description_full:
【雙面神姬．正式上市】國民女神 林莎Lisa 傾情推薦！

神性無禁，隨心主宰，覺醒就在今日！

嘿，預言中的旅者！歡迎來到伊莫塔爾大陸。

雖然世界正被幽影侵蝕，但別擔心，拯救世界不必一個人硬扛！在《雙面神姬》，上百位東西方傳奇神明正等著與你簽下契約。

這裡沒有繁瑣的練功地獄，只有懂你、會陪你聊天的 AI靈魂伴侶。現在踏入大陸，我們準備了地區限定神姬、免費抽卡、粉鑽等超多福利 ，讓你出發即巔峰！轉動命運輪盤，這一次，你的傳奇由你做主。

神性自由，萬相顯化 —— 視覺與設定的雙重盛宴
厭倦了千篇一律的神明形象？在這裡，女媧、宙斯、媽祖、雅典娜皆擁有截然不同的「另一面」。性轉、黑化、成長前後的極致反差，每位神姬都提供至少兩種形態的獨立設定與華麗外觀。這不只是收集，更是探索神明隱秘真相的頂級美學之旅。

神力加持，天命逆轉 —— 執掌因果的終極博弈
命運輪盤與烏鴉信使隨侍左右。透過獨特的占卜系統，戰場局勢不再只是單純的數值輾壓。每一次轉動輪盤，都是對未知的獻祭，或是逆轉勝的奇蹟。在因果交織的迷霧中，你的直覺與抉擇，將成為改寫神界規則的唯一籌碼。

神域亂鬥，協力遠征 —— 東西傳說的巔峰對決
想像媽祖與宙斯並肩作戰的場景嗎？遊戲收錄上百位橫跨東西方文化的神祇，在史詩級遠征中，與公會夥伴協力挑戰強大首領。無論是東方的繾綣神韻，還是西方的殺伐之力，都將在你的指尖匯聚，組建跨越文明的夢幻戰隊。

AI神姬，真的懂你 —— 會聊天、會占卜、會變裝的「活」角色
她，絕不是冰冷的數據。內建AI智能交互系統，你可以與神姬實時對話，她會根據你的話題做出個性化回應。每日占卜揭示運勢。更驚喜的是，輸入提示詞就能讓神姬換上你理想中的裝扮，真正打造獨一無二、住在你手機裡的她。

神格共鳴，升級無壓 —— 全員共享的極致進化
徹底告別繁瑣枯燥的練等過程！只需精心培養你的核心小隊，透過「共鳴」系統，其餘所有神明都能同步共享等級與境界。抽到心儀的新神姬，一鍵繼承所有資源戰力，讓你在快節奏生活中，優雅享受純粹的養成樂趣。

data.name: ReTown
data.description_full:
In ReTown, every sunrise marks not just another day of survival, but a shift in the very foundation of the world around you. As the sun rises, the once-familiar terrain mutates—land masses tilt, new pathways emerge, and towering ridges rise from the ground, altering the battlefield and forcing you to rethink your every move. This isn’t just a fight against the undead—it’s a fight against the land itself.

At the heart of this chaos stands your Sacred Tree, a glowing monument of life in a rotting world. Its roots run deep, binding together the last fragments of nature’s magic. If it falls, so does all hope. Each night, waves of zombies swarm from every direction—shambling corpses, feral sprinters, armored abominations—each deadlier and more cunning than the last.

Survival isn’t just about swinging a weapon; it’s about adapting. Craft fortifications from scarce resources, place traps in shifting chokepoints, and upgrade your defenses to withstand the coming night. Your enemies will learn—they will climb, break, and swarm in new ways, testing every weak point in your strategy.

But danger also brings opportunity. As you explore the unstable terrain, you’ll uncover hidden resource caches, rare weapons, and ancient relics to empower your defenses. Every decision matters—do you risk venturing further for a powerful upgrade, or stay close to protect the tree?

The undead are relentless. The world is unpredictable. The only constant… is the fight.
data.description_short: Every sunrise brings new challenges

data.description_full:
＼豪華声優陣が演じる異世界男子と紡ぐ、レストラン経営物語／
レストランを経営するあなたは、ある日お店ごと異世界にトリップ！？
総勢24人の豪華声優陣が出演する、600種類以上の料理とレストラン経営が楽しめる

女性向けゲームが好きな方必見！忙しくても安心な、ながらプレイができるオートシステムを搭載。
600種類以上の料理が彩る、あなただけのレストランを豪華声優陣が演じる異世界男子と共に楽しもう！


現代の日本でオーベルジュ型のレストランを営むあなたは、
とある出来事がきっかけで、（半ば強引に）レストランごと異世界に連れてこられてしまった。

元の世界に戻る条件はただひとつ。
「６つの国に暮らす王子たちの閉ざされた心を開くこと」

彼らが抱える問題に、世界を蝕む時空の歪み……。
剣も魔法もないなかで、このピンチを救えるのは、
あなたがレストランで作るとびきり美味しい料理だった？



◆ ちょっぴり癖つよ！？魅力的な異世界男子たち◆
6カ国の王子をはじめ、家令、側近、騎士、画家、学者、陰陽師、辺境伯など、
多彩な肩書きを持つ魅力的なキャラクター24人が登場！
彼らと一緒にレストランを経営すると好感度がアップし、意外な一面が見られるかも？
人気声優陣が演じるキャラクターボイスはホーム画面でも楽しめ、時間によってセリフが変化！


◆料理を販売してレシピを解放しよう◆
レストランで販売した料理の種類が増えると、次々と新しい料理レシピを思い出す！
登場する料理は600種類以上、続々と新レシピを追加予定！
実在するおなじみの料理から、異世界ならではの珍しい料理まで盛りだくさん！
料理を販売して人気レストランを目指し、料理図鑑を埋めていこう！


◆新感覚レストラン経営シミュレーションゲーム◆
あなたのレストラン経営センスが試される！
料理の需要や天候、接続されている国の特徴をうまく活用し、レストランの売上アップを目指そう！
日々変化する状況に合わせて、最適なレストラン経営戦略を考える楽しさが満載！

1.国や流行を見ながら、その日レストランで販売する料理メニューを決定！
2.レストランで働くスタッフを配置
3.営業開始！料理の売れ行きやスタッフの働きを見守ろう
4.閉店、結果報告。結果を元に明日のお店の営業内容を考えよう


◆ハートウォーミングなストーリー◆
6カ国の王子や彼らを支える仲間たちと紡ぐ、ハートウォーミングなストーリー。
ワケあり王子たちの過去には一体何が…？
あなたは彼らと心を通わすことができるのか！？
この「異世界」で起きている異変を、レストランで作る料理を通じて紐解いていく。
美麗なイラスト（キャラクターデザイン：黒裄）と、人気声優陣が演じる個性豊かなキャラクターたちとの物語を楽しもう！

data.description_full:
【Oyuna Genel Bakış】
Sıradan bir lise öğrencisi, bir gün aniden ortaya çıkan "Öte Dünya İstilası" olayının ortasında kalır. Çaresizliğin eşiğindeki bu genç, kendi ruhsal enerjisini kontrol etme yeteneğini uyandırır ve saldırıdan kıl payı kurtulmayı başarır.

Ertesi gün, kendilerine "İttifak" diyen bir örgütün ajanı çıkagelir. Ajanın anlattıklarına göre bu dünya, öte dünyadan gelen "İntikamcı Ruhlar"ın tehdidi altındadır; ruhsal enerji yeteneğine sahip "Özel Güç Kullanıcıları" ise gölgelerin ardında onlara karşı savaşmaktadır.

Ajanın rehberliğinde lise öğrencisi, özel yeteneklileri eğiten "Ruhsal Enerji Akademisi"ne transfer olur. Ancak onu bekleyen şey; her biri kendine has kişiliklere sahip yoldaşlarıyla birlikte yapacağı zorlu antrenmanlar ve insanlığın varoluşunu tehdit eden güçlü ruhsal felaketlere karşı verilecek bir ölüm kalım savaşıdır.

【Öne Çıkan Özellikler】
▶ Benzersiz Güçlerini Uyandır, Kendi Kaderini Çiz

Her bir savaşçının kendine özgü yetenek sisteminin kilidini açıp derinlemesine geliştirin. Strateji ve bilgelikle dolu bu karakter geliştirme yolculuğunda, savaşçılarınızın savaş alanında fark yaratmasını sağlayın.

▶ Rüya Takımını Kur, Zafer İçin Savaş

Kendine has özelliklere sahip efsanevi savaşçıları toplayıp akıllıca eşleştirin. En güçlü 3 kişilik savaş kadronuzu kurarak, takım ruhunun savaş alanında ışıldamasına tanıklık edin.

▶ Akıcı Gerçek Zamanlı Savaşlar, Görkemli Kombolar

Heyecan dolu gerçek zamanlı savaşlarda yeteneklerinizi doğru zamanlamayla serbest bırakın. Göz kamaştırıcı kombolar yapın ve takım arkadaşlarınızla kusursuz bir uyum içinde güçlü düşmanları alt edin.

▶ Bölge Patronlarına Meydan Oku, Kahramanlığını Kanıtla

Arkadaşlarınızla omuz omuza savaşın veya çevrimiçi arenalarda kozlarınızı paylaşın. Güçlü bölge liderlerine meydan okuyarak gücünüzü kanıtlayın ve kendi efsanenizi yazın.

【Bize Katılın ve Bu Gizemli Maceraya Atılın】
Yeni bir tehdit sessizce yaklaşıyor, dünya kurtarılmayı bekliyor. Oyunu hemen indir ve özel güçlerle dolu macera dolu yolculuğuna başla! En güncel haberlerden anında haberdar olmak ve size özel ödülleri kaçırmamak için resmi topluluk sayfalarımızı takip edin!

data.name: EchoNest
data.description_full:
EchoNest is a minimalist spatial puzzle game that challenges you to strategically place blocks on a 6x6 grid. Perfect for short play sessions during breaks or commutes.

**How to Play:**
- Place nest blocks to cover all empty cells on the grid
- Each block can be rotated 90 degrees before placement
- Limited moves per level - plan your placements carefully
- Obstacles block certain cells, adding complexity to each puzzle

**Features:**
- 40 campaign levels with progressive difficulty

data.name: Number Clear - Match Master
data.description_full:
Game Introduction
✨ Looking for a way to unwind while keeping your mind sharp? Number Clear is the perfect number logic game for you. It features simple, intuitive rules, yet every elimination move is packed with strategic fun.
☕ Whether you’re killing time during your commute or seeking a peaceful space to think after a busy day, Number Clear delivers the purest, most refreshing puzzle experience. Challenge yourself, beat your high score, and enjoy the ultimate sense of relief as numbers vanish from the board one by one!
How to Play
🎯 Objective: Clear all number tiles from the board and aim for a perfect full clear!
🔢 Matching: Find pairs of identical numbers (e.g., 5 and 5) or numbers that add up to 10 (e.g., 3 and 7).
⚡ Elimination: Connect two numbers horizontally, vertically, or diagonally as long as there are no obstacles between them.
➕ Progression: When no more moves are available, tap the button at the bottom to add extra rows of remaining numbers and use your wits to find new opportunities in the number grid.
Game Features
🚀 Epic Power-Ups: Stuck on a puzzle? Use the Sledgehammer to break a single obstacle, or activate the Logic Tornado to reshuffle the board and unlock brand-new possibilities.
🎨 Minimalist Design: Free from clutter. A clean UI paired with soothing sound effects helps you focus purely on logic and slip quickly into a deep “flow state.”
🏆 Daily Challenges: Fresh, unique puzzles every day. Complete objectives to collect exclusive trophies and make your mark on the global leaderboard.
📡 Play Offline: Fully supports offline mode. Enjoy a quick mental workout anytime, whether on the subway or a plane.
🧘 Stress-Free Experience: No time limits, no forced countdowns — solve puzzles at your own pace and savor the fun.
Pro Player Winning Strategies
💡 Think Globally: Don’t just focus on adjacent numbers! Watch the connections between the end of one row and the start of the next — high-scoring matches often hide there.
💡 Priority Rule: Prioritize combinations that block pathways to free up space for large-scale eliminations later.
💡 Item Management: Earn coins through chain eliminations and use power-ups strategically in key levels to maintain your win streak.
🌈 If you love Sudoku, crossword puzzles, 2048, or number merge games, Number Clear is the perfect choice for you!
🔥 Ready to clear the board? Download Number Clear now and start your number-matching journey — every elimination brings a rush of accomplishment!

매 순간 선택이 결과를 바꾼다.

Nuts Match: Sort Puzzle is the most satisfying nuts and bolts sorting game around.

Twist colorful nuts onto matching screws until every single bolt holds one matching color. Easy to learn but hard to put down, this screw sort puzzle turns simple color matching into hours of brain-teasing, mind-bending fun. 🧠

Tap, move, match and sort your way through thousands of handcrafted levels, from relaxing easy boards to expert nut-and-bolt brain teasers. Whether you have one minute or one hour to spare, Nuts Match is the perfect color sort puzzle to keep your mind sharp and your hands busy.

You never sort alone! A cute little robot sits in the middle of the board and reacts to your every move: its eyes light up with hearts, it
cheers when you clear a stack, and its glowing pixel screen shines brighter the more nuts you match. The more colors you sort, the happier your robot gets. Solving puzzles has never felt this friendly or this rewarding.

🎮 HOW TO PLAY: SIMPLE & RELAXING
• Tap a bolt to pick up the top colored nut.
• Tap another screw to drop it onto a nut of the same color.

What begins as a straightforward challenge quickly evolves into a rewarding test of logic and spatial awareness. Every arrow influences the puzzle around it. Some moves create opportunities, while others may block future progress. Understanding these relationships is the key to mastering the game.

Arrow Frenzy: Tap Out Puzzle delivers a satisfying gameplay loop built around observation, prediction, and strategy. Players constantly evaluate possible moves, search for hidden solutions, and experience rewarding moments when a clever sequence unlocks the entire board.

Unlike many puzzle games that depend on matching colors or collecting items, Arrow Frenzy focuses entirely on logical movement and strategic thinking. The result is a clean, focused puzzle experience that remains engaging from the first level to the last.

The game's minimalist presentation enhances the challenge by removing unnecessary distractions. Every element serves a purpose, allowing players to concentrate fully on solving puzzles and improving their skills.

As you advance through the game, levels become increasingly creative and complex. New layouts require deeper analysis, better planning, and stronger problem-solving abilities. Each completed puzzle feels like a genuine accomplishment.

Arrow Frenzy is perfect for players who enjoy:

The flexible gameplay allows you to enjoy quick sessions throughout the day or settle in for extended puzzle-solving marathons. Every level offers a fresh challenge and a new opportunity to sharpen your thinking skills.

Key Features:

data.name: Card Jam: Word Puzzle
data.description_full:
🌸 Sort It Out — Moves Matter, Categories Grow! 🌸

Flowers, fruits, animals, toys, fairies… all mixed up in one big pile. Your job? Drag every card into its matching category. Sounds easy? Wait until you see the move counter.

🎯 How It Works
Each level gives you a limited number of moves. Every time you drag a card to a category, that’s one move. You need to sort every single card before your moves run out. No pressure… right?

🧠 One Done, More Appear
Here’s the twist: as soon as you finish sorting one category, new cards of a random new type pop onto the board. Just when you thought you were done, the game says, “Oh, by the way, here come the vegetables / robots / unicorns…” You’ll have to keep adapting.

🔄 Limited Moves, Endless Thinking
You can’t just throw cards around. A wrong move wastes precious attempts. You’ll need to plan ahead: which category to finish first? Which new type might appear? Should you leave a few cards unsorted to prepare for the surprise?

🌈 More Categories, More Chaos
As you level up, the board gets more crowded. Some categories look almost identical — are those cherries or tiny red balloons? Is that a fox or a dog? Your eyes and brain will get a real workout.

🏆 Beat the Move Limit
Every level is a new puzzle. Finish within the moves, and you move on. Exceed the moves, and you’ll have to try again. No timers, just careful thinking and satisfying clicks.

Ready to become a sorting master? Grab those cards, watch those moves, and tame the ever‑growing pile! 🌸🍎🐱🧸✨

data.name: Vault Bounce
data.description_full:
Vault Bounce is a quick one-hand arcade bounce game built around charged shots, clean landings, and short score-chasing runs.

Pull back from the ball, release to launch, and aim for the next safe pad. Collect coins, charge stronger shots with magnet boosts, avoid spike platforms, and touch crown rings to trigger automatic jackpot bounce chains.

CORE FEATURES

DRAG-TO-LAUNCH CONTROL
Pull back, aim the arc, and release with direct touch control.

SAFE PAD CLIMBING
Land cleanly on vault pads to keep the run alive and build score.

REWARD PICKUPS
Coins add bonus points, while magnet boosts charge a stronger next shot.

CROWN JACKPOT CHAINS
Touch a crown ring to activate automatic multi-hop jackpot movement.

HAZARD PRESSURE
Spike platforms end the run when the ball lands on them, so every shot needs timing and aim.

CLEAR SESSION FLOW
Start from a focused home screen, read icon-based rules, pause anytime, restart quickly, and review each result.

LOCAL BEST SCORE SAVE
Your best score is stored on the device so every run can push the record higher.

data.name: Dragon Raja: Thức Tỉnh
data.description_full:
"Là siêu phẩm thẻ bài RPG mới nhất thuộc series Dragon Raja, [Dragon Raja: Thức Tỉnh] mang đến trải nghiệm phiêu lưu vừa giải trí nhẹ nhàng vừa nhiệt huyết sục sôi! Hóa thân thành chiến binh hiện đại, bước vào thế giới săn rồng, khởi đầu hành trình bùng cháy từng khoảnh khắc - Chạm, vượt ải, diệt rồng, tất cả chỉ trong một nốt nhạc!
Nhà thám hiểm thân mến, cánh cổng Học viện Cassell đã rộng mở chào đón thế hệ săn rồng mới. Trước khi xuất phát, hãy xem qua Cẩm Nang Dũng Sĩ này, chuẩn bị hành trang để lao vào hành trình đan xen giữa nhiệt huyết và cảm động này nhé!

[Đăng Nhập Tặng 400 Lượt Quay, Erii SSR Miễn Phí]
Đăng nhập nhận ngay 400 Vé Chiêu Mộ, điểm danh mở khóa miễn phí SSR Uesugi Erii! Tỷ lệ nổ cực cao, Quay X10 ra 3 phẩm Vàng, cùng với vô số tài nguyên tiếp tế miễn phí, quất gacha không phải rầu, dễ dàng xây dựng đội hình cực mạnh.

[Nhân Vật Kinh Điển, Lập Đội Săn Rồng]
Các nhân vật kinh điển nguyên tác như Lộ Minh Phi, Sở Tử Hàng, Erii, NoNo... toàn bộ quy tụ, tái hiện thần thái nhân vật với độ chính xác cao, kết hợp hiệu ứng động tinh tế, làm sống lại dáng vẻ nhiệt huyết trong ký ức. Tự do xây dựng đội săn rồng độc quyền, cơ chế đổi thẻ không tổn thất giúp tùy ý điều chỉnh đội hình, thích ứng mọi chiến trường.

[Treo Máy Rảnh Tay, Xong Nhanh Nhiệm Vụ]
Hệ thống hiệu suất độc quyền ""cày game nhẹ nhàng"", quét nhanh mọi nhiệm vụ ngày, rảnh rang đôi tay không cần thao tác rườm rà. Đơn giản hóa quy trình cốt lõi, tích hợp các lối chơi tần suất cao, tái định nghĩa trải nghiệm RPG thư giãn, tận dụng thời gian rảnh rỗi tăng đều Lực Chiến, thỏa sức tận hưởng niềm vui phiêu lưu và chiến thuật.

[Đấu Trường Đỉnh Cao, Tranh Hùng Học Viện]
Đấu Trường Đỉnh Cao chính thức mở cửa, các chiến binh cùng tranh tài, đoạt lấy vinh quang và phần thưởng độc quyền ""Chuyên Viên Mạnh Nhất Học Viện"". Thức tỉnh Ngôn Linh kết hợp hiệu ứng hoành tráng chuẩn nguyên tác, những khung hình bùng nổ như Hắc Nhật nở rộ, Quân Diễm ầm vang, đẩy căng sức nóng nhiệt huyết trong từng trận đấu.

[Ngoại Hình Thời Thượng, Chế Tạo Tự Do]
Đội ngũ thiết kế hàng đầu trau chuốt từng tạo hình nhân vật, kho Ngoại Hình thời thượng tự do phối đồ, tùy chỉnh toàn diện tạo hình riêng biệt. Đồ họa thế hệ mới, đặc tả chuyển động mượt mà tinh tế, tái hiện sống động các danh cảnh nguyên tác, mỗi khung hình đều là một bữa tiệc thị giác đã mắt.

[Dàn Lồng Tiếng Đỉnh Cao, Lồng Tiếng Nhật Nguyên Bản]
Lồng tiếng đa ngôn ngữ đồng hành cùng hành trình thám hiểm! Dàn diễn viên lồng tiếng đình đám tạo nên giai điệu phiêu lưu độc quyền, sẽ tiếp thêm nhiệt huyết bất tận cho chuyến đi của bạn! Mỗi đoạn nhạc đều sẽ trở thành người bạn đồng hành tuyệt vời nhất trên chặng đường phiêu lưu!"

data.name: Bubble Association
data.description_full:
Welcome to Bubble Association, a fun and relaxing puzzle game that tests your logic and association skills!!

Unlike traditional match-3 games where you look for identical items, Bubble Association challenges you to find the "connection" between different things. Whether it's a group of related images or associated words, drag them together to merge and clear the board!

🕹️ How to Play

Find the Connection: Observe the images or words inside the bubbles and figure out what they have in common.

Drag to Sort: Drag a bubble and drop it onto another related bubble to group them together.

Clear and Win: Successfully categorize all associated bubbles to pop them and clear the level!

🌟 Game Features

Dual Gameplay Modes: Enjoy both Image Categorization and Word Association. Test your visual recognition and vocabulary!

Diverse Themes: Explore levels featuring animals, food, daily objects, portraits, and more.

Relaxing & Satisfying: Experience the joy of organizing a messy board into neat categories and watching them pop.

Train Your Brain: Easy to pick up but engaging enough to keep your mind sharp. Perfect for short breaks!

Download Bubble Association now and start sorting your way to victory!

data.name: Arrow quest:Lucky Reward
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrow Quest: Lucky Reward — a gentle puzzle journey where every arrow has somewhere to go.

On each board, arrows point in different directions. Some look left, some look right, others up or down. Your task is simple but thoughtful: release each arrow the way it faces, and watch it slide off the board. No dragging. No rotating. Just pure, careful decision-making.

But there's a quiet challenge beneath the calm surface. If two arrows cross paths and touch, your run loses one chance. You begin every level with three tries. Let them collide too many times, and you'll need to start over.

This is not a game about speed. It's about seeing the board clearly before making a move. Which arrow should go first? Which one is trapped until another leaves? Step by step, the puzzle unfolds like a gentle riddle.

The visuals are soft and clean. The sounds are light and rewarding. Each solved level brings a small sense of progress — like finishing a page in a favorite book.

Whether you have one minute or one hour, Arrow Quest fits quietly into your day. No rush. No timers. Just arrows, logic, and a little bit of luck.

Can you guide every arrow home without a single mistake? Download Arrow Quest: Lucky Reward and begin your journey today.
data.description_short: Guide each arrow home along its path — a quiet puzzle of direction and patience.

data.name: Город грехов: Путь босса
data.description_full:
Добро пожаловать в Город грехов: Путь босса!

Здесь власть не дают просто так. Её забирают силой, хитростью и верными людьми. Улицы полны денег, предательства и опасных сделок, а каждый район ждёт того, кто сможет подчинить его себе.

Начните путь с самых низов и станьте боссом криминальной империи. Нанимайте людей вне закона, головорезов, карателей и главарей, собирайте сильный отряд, усиливайте персонажей, забирайте ресурсы и расширяйте своё влияние. В этом городе вы либо правите, либо становитесь чьей-то добычей.

[Соберите свою банду]
Нанимайте мафиози, уличных бойцов, гонщиков, байкеров и подпольных боссов со всего Города грехов. У каждого персонажа своя роль, стиль боя и набор навыков. Комбинируйте урон, защиту, контроль и поддержку, чтобы собрать отряд, который сможет разнести любого противника.

[Сражайтесь без лишней рутины]
Автобой берёт грязную работу на себя. Развивайте персонажей, подбирайте состав команды, усиливайте экипировку и грамотно распределяйте ресурсы, а ваша банда сама разберётся с теми, кто встанет у неё на пути. Уличные стычки, войны за территорию и ежедневные подземелья станут проще и быстрее.

[Забирайте добычу каждый день]
Улицы щедры к тем, кто не боится драки. Проходите ежедневные испытания, побеждайте противников и получайте ресурсы для прокачки команды. Каждая победа усиливает вашу банду, расширяет влияние и приближает вас к вершине криминального мира.

[Постройте преступную империю]
Казино, ночные клубы, подпольный бизнес и грязные деньги: всё это может работать на вас. Развивайте свою организацию, объединяйтесь с другими игроками, укрепляйте синдикат и превращайте уличную банду в настоящую мафиозную империю.

[Живите как настоящий босс]
Дорогие машины, роскошные особняки, горы налички, эффектные спутницы и власть над городом. Наслаждайтесь жизнью на вершине, но помните: чем выше вы поднимаетесь, тем больше желающих сбросить вас вниз.

[Пройдите путь власти и предательства]
Вас ждёт история амбиций, мести, опасных союзов и жестокой борьбы за влияние. Вы встретите союзников и противников, примете непростые решения и сами определите свою судьбу. Останетесь мелким уличным головорезом или станете главным боссом Города грехов?

Войдите в Город грехов: Путь босса прямо сейчас. Призывайте людей вне закона, усиливайте банду, проходите испытания, захватывайте улицы и постройте собственную криминальную империю!

data.name: イナズマイレブン クロス
data.description_full:
いつでもどこでも　サッカーやろうぜ！

■『イナズマイレブン クロス』とは 

レベルファイブが贈る「イナズマイレブン」シリーズの新作がスマートフォンに登場！
新たな主人公が繰り広げるオリジナルストーリー！
スキマ時間でいつでも、どこでも遊べる超次元サッカー育成シミュレーションゲーム。
自分だけのドリームチームを育成し、試合に挑もう！

▼あらすじ

日本代表イナズマジャパンは、大型クルーズ船『イナズマビッグフェリー』に乗り、
全世界が注目する少年サッカーの祭典
『フットボールフロンティア・インターナショナル（ＦＦＩ）』を勝ち進んでいた。
しかし、大会中に監督が突然の退任を発表する。
次の監督に指名されたのは、チームの補佐をしていた主人公・汐沢(しおさわ) 陽(よう)だった。
いきなりの監督任命に戸惑いながらも、陽は戦術分析能力を活かし、
キャプテンの円堂守や選手たちと力を合わせて、世界の頂点に立つ。

ところが、突如発生した謎の地震で意識を失い、
目覚めた時には、円堂たちの記憶から陽の存在だけが消えていた。
さらに、仲間だったエースストライカー豪炎寺修也と、ゲームメイカー鬼道有人が
帝国学園の姿で敵として現れ、冷たい視線で勝負を挑んでくるのだった。

記憶の消失、改変された関係、変わってしまった世界──
すべての真相を求め、陽は未知なる未来へと進み始める。


▼スキマ時間で手軽に遊べる！戦術重視のコマンドバトル

試合はコマンド選択のみの簡単操作！
さらに完全オートでの試合進行も可能なため、アクションが苦手な方や移動中のスキマ時間でも、手軽にゲームを楽しめます。
選手を鍛え、チームに編成することで、監督としてオリジナルチームを育成。
あなたの采配が試合の勝敗を分ける、奥深い戦略性を体感しよう！

▼こんな人にオススメ！
・「イナズマイレブン」シリーズが好き
・超次元サッカーを楽しみたい
・育成シミュレーションゲームが好き
・自分だけの最強チームを作りたい
・スキマ時間に手軽にゲームを遊びたい
・戦術や采配で勝負するゲームが好き
・熱いスポーツストーリーが好き

data.name: Her Jigsaw Story
data.description_full:
A shattered life. A mother’s courage. A puzzle to rebuild it all. Experience an emotional story-driven puzzle game where every merge and split brings hope back from the ashes.

Her Jigsaw Story weaves deep narrative with innovative puzzle gameplay. You follow a brave woman who loses everything—her family, her home, and most painfully, her daughter. But she refuses to break. Through hardship and heartbreak, she rises again, rebuilds her life with relentless strength, and journeys toward the one moment that matters most: reuniting with her child.

The story is told through artistic jigsaw puzzles—each piece of art captures a key emotion: loss, struggle, resilience, and love.


Unique Puzzle Mechanic:
Each picture is divided into blocks on a grid. Move these blocks to reassemble the full image. When matching blocks touch, they automatically merge into larger pieces. When you need to rearrange, blocks can split apart. Find the perfect arrangement to restore each memory.

Every completed puzzle unlocks a new chapter of her journey. The scattered pieces of her life slowly come together—just like the puzzles you solve.

Can you help her piece everything back together?


Key Features:

Emotional storytelling of rebirth and motherly love;
Innovative merge & split puzzle mechanics;
Beautiful art tied directly to the story;
Relaxing yet thoughtful gameplay;


Rebuild her world. One puzzle. One memory. One hug.

data.name: Slide Arrows Match
data.description_full:
"Slide Arrows Match" is an addictive logic puzzle game. The game screen is a grid filled with colored arrows, each pointing in a different direction. Your goal is to tap these arrows, causing them to move in the direction they point, until all arrows are off the screen. Sounds simple? Don't underestimate it—the difficulty increases as you progress!

Game Features
Basic Controls: Tap to select an arrow, and the arrow will move in the direction it points.If an arrow collides with another arrow in its forward direction, it will lose one health point. You have three health points; once you run out, you must start over.
Guidance: Each arrow in the game has an extension line indicating its forward direction.
Four different game color schemes are available to suit different gaming preferences.

Slide Rules:
Arrows can only move in the direction they point.
Only one arrow can be moved at a time.
Arrows cannot pass through other arrows.
Winning Condition: Win the level when all arrows on the board are off the screen.

How to Play
Start from the Edges: Focus on aligning arrows to the edges first—they have fewer movement options and are easier to lock onto.
You'll love it for its clean, minimalist visual design paired with vibrant arrow colors. Relaxing background music and satisfying sliding sound effects. Hundreds of progressively challenging levels. Suitable for all ages—the perfect choice for commuting, mental training, or relaxation. Ready to match? Whether you want to kill time on your commute, exercise your logic, or simply enjoy a light yet challenging puzzle game, Slide Arrows Match is for you. Research shows that playing these spatial reasoning puzzles helps improve planning skills and mental agility! Challenge yourself—how fast can you finish them all?
data.description_short: Slide & match arrows to solve brain-teasing puzzles! Simple rules, endless fun!

data.name: Vita Sort
data.description_full:
Vita Sort - Exclusive Puzzle, Strategic Categorization
Vita Sort is an exclusive Mahjong tile categorization puzzle game. We are thrilled to present this fresh title that blends classic Mahjong visual art with innovative gameplay. Featuring clear, large Mahjong tiles and a user-friendly interface compatible with phones, our goal is to provide a relaxing yet mentally engaging experience for all players, particularly focused on older adults.
How to Play Vita Sort:
Playing Vita Sort is intuitive, with its core mechanics centered around your meticulous observation, clever categorization, and strategic tapping to effectively manage the tiles and collection areas.
1. Tap to Collect: Tap any available Mahjong tile on the board, and it will first move into the temporary tray at the bottom.
2. Activate & Categorize:
- The top of the screen features 3 main category slots, displaying active Mahjong tile categories and their collection progress (e.g., "Characters 2/4").
- When a Mahjong tile enters the temporary tray, if it belongs to a category already represented in one of the main category slots, all matching tiles in the tray will automatically categorize and count towards that main slot's progress.
- If the tile belongs to a new major category and there's an empty main category slot at the top, that new category will be activated and occupy a slot.
3. Complete & Clear: Once the number of Mahjong tiles in a main category slot reaches its target requirement, that category will be fully collected and disappear from the slot, freeing up space for new categories.
4. Strategic Planning: The temporary tray has limited space. You need to plan your taps in advance, ensuring each tap effectively contributes to completing a main category. Avoid filling the tray with too many un-categorizable tiles, which could lead to a stalled game.
5. Clear the Board Challenge: Your ultimate goal is to use your wisdom to gradually clear all Mahjong tiles from the board, successfully completing each level!
Exclusive Vita Sort Game Features:
- "Tile Fusion Sort" Innovative Gameplay: Moving beyond traditional matching, we introduce the unique "Tile Fusion Sort" innovative gameplay. This is more than just simple sorting; it's a comprehensive test of your ability to quickly identify, precisely categorize, and strategically plan your moves.
- Classic Mahjong Art Style: The game features classic Mahjong tile visuals, paired with hundreds of meticulously designed board layouts, offering a familiar yet fresh visual feast.
- Large-Scale, Easy-to-Read Design: Designed with players in mind, we use large, clear, and easy-to-read Mahjong tiles and text, allowing you to say goodbye to the strain of small fonts and fully enjoy a comfortable game.
- Mentally Engaging Levels: Each level is thoughtfully designed to activate your mind, helping you enhance your categorization thinking, observation skills, concentration, and short-term memory in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.
- Super Combo Experience: When you cleverly strategize to trigger a continuous collection and elimination of many Mahjong tiles in one go, you'll unlock a thrilling Super Combo, gaining extraordinary game satisfaction and rewards!
- Helpful Auxiliary Tools: The game provides free and useful tools, such as the Undo function to correct mistakes, and the Shuffle tool to open up new possibilities, helping you overcome challenging situations.
- Offline Mode: Full offline support lets you immerse yourself in the fun of Vita Sort anytime, anywhere, without needing an internet connection.
Vita Sort is a meticulously crafted puzzle masterpiece designed for players who love strategic categorization and visual puzzle-solving games.
Note: This is a puzzle game in the style of Mahjong tiles, focused on categorization. It does not contain the rules of traditional Mahjong, Mahjong Solitaire, or other types of card games. The term “Mahjong” here refers solely to the visual style of the tiles.
data.description_short: Vita Sort: Mahjong tile sort puzzle. Plan, categorize, relax & train brain.

THE GEOMETRIC PUZZLE OF YOUR DREAMS

data.name: Ladies Don’t Tempt Immortality
data.description_full:
Survive the Ultimate Temptation on Your Path to Immortality! 🌸⚔️

You are Lin Fan, the chosen one of the Crane Illusion Sect. Born with a Pure Yang Lineage, you are destined to ascend to the heavens.

However, no matter how hard you train, fate sends yet another challenge in your way. Challenges in the shape of seven dangerously beautiful women. Your master is chaotic and unreliable. Your senior sister disciplines first, asks questions never. The sect saintess seems personally invested in making sure your Dao heart doesn't survive the week. And that's just the beginning.

Can you survive the thousand tribulations of love, jealousy, and thunder? Or will your heart fall just before your heavenly ascension?

Your journey to enlightenment is blocked by seven unique temptations, each with its own agenda 💘

- Jing Wuyu (The Mischievous Immortal): Chaotic yet caring, her unorthodox lessons often come with a steep price.
- Lan Yunrou (The Martial Mistress): Elegant, severe, and secretly protective... but mercy isn't part of her training plan.
- Bai Wanwan (The Foxy Seductress): Every smile is temptation, every look a tribulation. Determined to tempt you from your destiny, her past unknown...
- Lei Xiao (The Lightning Immortal): Unpredictable, dangerous, and literally shocking.
- Wenren Lanke (The Innocent Troublemaker): A sweet appearance hides the undisputed problem-child of the Sect.
- Yin Ping'er (The Poisoned Tea Saintess): Soft voice, poisonous charm... a beauty you'll never see coming.
- Pan Suqin (The Gentle Soul): The warmest embrace hides the sharpest knife.

Game Features 📖

- A Cinematic Live-Action FMV Experience: Stunning xianxia-inspired effects bring a mythic Chinese fantasy world to life. Feel the spark of every lightning strike!
- A First-Person Immortal Ascension Adventure: Step into the robes of Lin Fan and experience the world through his eyes. Every glance, every touch, and every whispered word can shake your Dao heart.
- Multiple Paths, Infinite Outcomes: Will you walk the merciless path of the true immortal, or lose yourself in mortal passion? Every choice leads to a different fate: enlightenment, downfall, or something in between.
- Train, Duel, and Survive Heavenly Tribulation: Quick-time trials, emotional duels, and comedic chaos await. Survive your master's "training," dodge objects thrown at you, and protect your Divine Essence… at all costs.

Key Highlights 🔑
- Immersive live-action FMV experience
- Chinese myth-inspired fantasy setting
- Multiple endings and branching choices
- Humor, romance, and supernatural chaos

data.name: Color Arc Spin
data.description_full:
Rotate a circle clockwise or counterclockwise by pressing left and right buttons. Inside the circle, a small ball jumps continuously, and the goal is to land it precisely on an arc segment that matches its color.

data.name: CrisisX
data.description_full:
A deadly mysterious virus outbreak wiped out most of the population within a few days, and the unknown infection continues to spread. People fled in chaos into the streets, only to realize that their homes had transformed into a post-apocalyptic wasteland, with toxic mutants and zombies roaming the city. Infrastructure is destroyed, and society and civilization have completely collapsed. Families were separated when fleeing into the wilderness.
Now, in this devastating doomsday, you are on your own! "SURVIVE" is the only thing that matters. How much longer can you make it out there?
CrisisX MAX. Your ultimate survival experience.

▶ The world is yours to discover! ◀
Embark on your unknown adventure by creating a realistic self-avatar and exploring every inch of a unique, wide-open world with one of the largest maps ever developed. Raid cities, bunkers, and other locations teeming with terrifying walking dead, or explore freezing cold forests in the highlands. The game mechanics restore realistic geographic and climate conditions in North America, enabling you to experience different environments, landscapes, weather, and time zones. Confront numerous unexpected and serious tasks in a life after the end of the world, and build yourself a last shelter in this fallen continent!

▶ New order & rules must be established! ◀
Survival of the fittest! Test your survival skills by finding food and water, and collecting essential but rare materials left from the civilized world. Scavenge resources through activities like cutting trees, mining, hunting, gathering, and fishing to gain enough leverage for surviving the last days and perhaps establishing yourself as the most powerful among the last survivors. After all, only the strongest will endure in the light of day!

▶ Knives out, fight or fight! ◀
Exterminate crowds of mutated zombies and shoot down threatening monsters of all kinds. Each infected individual has a different appearance and attacking pattern depending on its mutation routes. As the last survivor, observe and employ a wise strategy to eliminate and escape the state of decay!
Your most formidable enemies are other surviving human players! Do not blindly venture into the dead; instead, grip your weapon tightly, be vigilant, and keep your eyes open for other survivalists passing by, whether engaging in a 1vs1 battle or an alliance battle. The distinction between a loyal friend and a dangerous intruder is often a fine line.

▶ Together, we thrive! ◀
Gain a foothold first by constructing yourself a shelter and exploiting resources through activities like taming horses, building, planting, and breeding. Ally with other survivors, restore a community, and expand in this zombie apocalypse. Fight side by side with your fellow survivors to resist enemy attacks. Only together can we survive in the last days on Earth!

▶ Uncover the mystery behind the end of the world! ◀
On this action packed journey of survival, you’ll be facing different tasks, puzzles and riddles. Solve them to expose the truth of the shattered world and save the dying light of the civilization. Perhaps the destruction of the fallen humanity was not an accident! You may also find more clues to trace your family’s whereabouts!
CRISIS X is YOUR LAST CHANCE OF SURVIVAL!

data.name: Happy Arrow Trip

🧭 Welcome to Happy Arrow Trip – a brilliant and uniquely addictive arrow-logic maze adventure that gives your brain the ultimate, satisfying workout! 💪🧠

If you love pure logic challenges with a fresh twist, it’s time to embark on this vibrant geometric journey. 🎨✨

Your mission seems simple: guide arrows through intricate grids to their destinations. But this maze is alive with clever mechanics that will test your spatial awareness and strategic thinking!

🧩 Master the Amazing Maze Mechanics

🚧 Counted Obstacle Blocks
Paths are blocked by numbered tiles. Crash your arrows into them! Each hit lowers the number, and once it hits zero, the block vanishes to clear your way.

📏 Wider Big Arrows
Size matters! Encounter giant arrows that require extra space to maneuver through tight maze corridors. Can you open up a wide enough path for them?

🌀 Directional Portal Pipes
Slide into mysterious bending pipes just like a retro arcade game! These pipes instantly change your arrow's direction based on their corners. Watch the counter on the pipe – it only allows a limited number of passes! ⏱️

🌌 Cosmic Black Holes
Don’t fear the void! In this cosmic maze, arrows can safely pass directly through black holes to discover sneaky shortcuts. 🕳️✨

🎨 Vibrant Visual Skins
Solve puzzles in style with beautifully redesigned Colorful Arrows, featuring mesmerizing, real-time flowing light gradients. 🌈💡

✅ Simple to learn, yet delightfully challenging to master.

📲 Download Happy Arrow Trip now, plan your moves, and see how far your logic can take you! 🎯🚀

data.name: Arrow Lock
data.description_full:
Welcome to ArrowLock: Color Burst – the most vibrant, playful, and brain-teasing puzzle adventure designed for kids, families, and casual gamers of all ages!

Embark on a magical journey through starry skies and fairytale landscapes as you solve cute arrow grids, launch colorful paths, and burst matching lock bubbles! ArrowLock combines spatial logic, playful physics, and charming cartoon graphics into a delightful game that is easy to learn but offers hours of engaging fun.

🎯 THE ULTIMATE PUZZLE GAMEPLAY
In ArrowLock, the goal is simple: clear the grid to unlock the fun! The screen is split into two exciting zones:
• The Bottom Grid: A maze of colorful, interconnected C-shaped and line-shaped cartoon arrows that block each other's path.
• The Top Bouncing Zone: A matching grid filled with colorful lock bubbles that must be popped!

HOW TO PLAY:
1. Tap to Untangle: Find an arrow that has a clear path forward and tap it!
2. Launch & Fly: Watch the arrow smoothly slide out of the grid and fly into the bouncing zone.
3. Burst the Locks: The launched arrow will reflect and bounce off the walls, popping every lock bubble that matches its color!
4. Clear the Board: Pop all the locks to complete the level, unlock new areas, and collect shiny coins!

✨ A MAGICAL EXPERIENCE FOR KIDS & FAMILIES
• Whimsical Fairy-Tale Theme: Play over a beautiful hand-crafted backdrop featuring a cozy cartoon village, bridges, castles, clouds, and starry nights designed to inspire children’s imaginations.
• Gorgeous Glossy 3D Art: Clean vector designs, bright juicy pastel palettes (vibrant oranges, yellows, blues, and greens), and bubbly pop animations that look premium and satisfying on every screen.
• Play & Learn: A fantastic logic game that boosts kids' spatial reasoning, hand-eye coordination, and strategic problem-solving skills in a friendly, stress-free environment.
• Cozy & Relaxing: No strict timers, no high pressure, and no stressful penalties. Play at your own pace whenever and wherever you want!

🚀 DISCOVER AMAZING POWER-UPS & FEATURES
• Epic Special Skills: Stuck on a tricky level? Unleash the "Color Bomb" to burst multiple locks instantly, or trigger the "Snake Rush" for a fast and satisfying cleanup!
• Key & Lock Mechanics: Discover special locked regions on the grid. Find the key on the lock board, pop it, and release the locked arrows to solve the ultimate maze!
• Infinite Levels: Hundreds of unique puzzle configurations that grow gradually in complexity to keep your brain active and entertained.
• Complete Rebranding & Quality Assurance: Enjoy high-performance gameplay, highly responsive touch controls, and smooth cartoon animations built with maximum care.

Are you ready to untangle the colorful arrows, explore the magical castle village, and pop all the locking bubbles?

Download ArrowLock: Color Burst today and let the playful popping adventure begin!
data.description_short: Untangle and launch colorful arrows to burst matching locks in this fun puzzle!

data.name: Arrow Escape- Tap Logic Puzzle
data.description_full:
Master the Ultimate Arrow Gridlock!
Can you untangle the perfect logical knot? Welcome to Arrow Escape- Tap Logic Puzzle, a minimalist 2D puzzle game that tests your spatial logic and strategic thinking. Every block has a direction, and every move triggers a reaction. One wrong tap, and the entire grid becomes locked!

Look closely, find the hidden exit, and clear the path to escape!

💡 HOW TO PLAY

Tap to Move: Tap an arrow block to make it slide along its orthogonal path on the grid.

Respect the Order: Blocks will block each other! You must find the exact sequence of taps to release them safely.

Find the Escape: Only one arrow can break free first. Find the key that unlocks the chain reaction!

No Intersections: Every track is a flat 2D lane. No overlapping, no crossing — just pure geometric satisfaction.

🌟 GAME FEATURES

Pure Logical Chaos: Simple rules, but mind-bending gridlocks. A perfect brain workout!

Satisfyingly Crisp UI: Clean, high-contrast minimalist vector design with sharp visuals.

Zero Pressure, Pure Zen: No timers, no rush — just you against the interlocking maze.

Hundreds of Smart Levels: From small 4-arrow grids to massive, industrial-level traffic jams.

Will you get trapped in the loop or find the ultimate escape path? Download now and test your IQ!

Physically interact with the grid by sliding your finger across adjacent or diagonal letters to connect sequences. Build meaningful words to clear the board, score points, and stay alive!

👉 Intuitive Swipe Controls
Freely connect letters in any direction—up, down, left, right, and diagonally! Just swipe to construct your words.

When a valid word is formed, the connected letter blocks gracefully merge and clear out of the grid, rewarding you with a satisfying visual effect and a boost to your score.

🌪️ Gravity-Driven Combos
Clearing words is just the beginning! Once blocks disappear, suspended letters physically drop down due to gravity. This dynamically reshapes the board, creating thrilling chain reactions and massive combo opportunities!

🏆 Reflexes Meet Strategy
It's not just about knowing words; it's about finding them under pressure. Perfect your quick decision-making skills and push your vocabulary to the absolute limit.

data.name: 凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊
data.description_full:
凹嗚...嗚...嗚...
嘘.....小鎮的迷霧中，誰在說謊？

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》是一款燒腦沉浸式推理解謎遊戲，你將化身偵探警長，踏入迷霧籠罩的謊言小鎮。這裡的每個居民都戴著面具，每段對話都可能暗藏玄機，而你，要靠著邏輯與細心，揪出藏在其中的真相。

-遊戲特色-
【與角色對話，在字裡行間捕捉線索】
眾多NPC各有獨立故事與行為邏輯，談話中的閃爍其詞、細節的偏差，都可能成為揭穿偽裝的關鍵線索。點擊角色就能標記「好人」或「狼人」，標對就能解鎖新提示，全程沒有複雜操作，新手也能輕輕鬆鬆上手。

【邏輯為刃，識破偽裝者】
狼人潛伏在好人之中，用言語編織騙局。遊戲以邏輯排除法為核心，透過交叉驗證線索、串聯關鍵信息，靠著嚴謹推理，就能撕開謊言，讓真相浮出水面。

【多重謎題，每一步都決定結局】
從對話選擇到線索拼合，每個決策都會影響調查方向。多重關卡逐級升級，每局2-5分鐘就能完成，純文字推理燒腦又解压，適合碎片時間玩，揪出所有狼人，才能驅散迷霧，守護小鎮。

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》——真相，從來不只一面。
挑戰你的推理極限，在真話與謊言之間，做出最終審判，一起走進這場充滿玄機的文字迷宮吧。

data.name: Chicken Road Map

Chicken Road Map
Test your reflexes and stay quick on your feet in this vibrant arcade dash!

Are you ready for a fast-paced challenge? In Chicken Road Map, you take control of a nimble chicken on a mission to gather falling treasures. The pipes above are constantly dropping rewards, and it is your job to ensure none of them hit the ground. Move fast, stay focused, and see how high you can push your score!

🎮 How to Play:
• Catch the Rewards: Move your character back and forth to catch falling coins directly into your basket.

• Stay Alert: The items drop continuously from the pipes. You must react quickly to reach every target.

• Master the Pace: As you progress, the speed increases. The longer you survive, the more intense the challenge becomes!

• Aim for the Record: Your goal is simple — collect as much as possible and beat your personal high score.

✨ Key Features:
• 🕹️ Simple One-Touch Controls: Easy-to-learn mechanics that make it perfect for players of all ages to pick up and play.

• 📈 Increasing Difficulty: Experience a dynamic challenge where your reaction time is truly put to the test.

• 🏃 Endless Gameplay: No limits to your run! Keep going as long as you can keep up with the falling speed.

• 🎨 Bright Visual Style: Enjoy playful and colorful graphics that create a fun atmosphere for every session.

• 🏆 Skill-Based Action: A pure arcade experience focused on timing, movement, and precision.

Chicken Road Map is the perfect game for quick breaks or long-term practice. How many can you gather before the pace becomes too fast?

Download Chicken Road Map today and start your ultimate catching quest!

data.name: Đạo Sĩ Bắt Trương Phi
data.description_full:
Đạo Sĩ Bắt Trương Phi: Vua Bùa Chú #1 Việt Nam

Một cõi giới ngập tràn tà khí dần hé mở, nơi quỷ thần lẩn khuất trong từng khoảng không và những pháp trận bùng sáng giữa màn sương đặc quánh. Bạn nhập vai đạo sĩ bước đi trên lằn ranh âm - dương, họa phù chú, dựng đàn tế, trấn phong những linh hồn cuồng loạn đang thức tỉnh. Từ ánh linh hỏa bốc lên nơi pháp đàn đến khoảnh khắc phong ấn nghẹt thở, mọi trải nghiệm đều phủ màu ma mị và căng thẳng tột độ. Ở đó, bạn nắm giữ quyền năng thao túng âm dương, khắc chế tà lực và xoay chuyển thế trận bằng chính đạo thuật của mình trong một thế giới quỷ thần đầy sống động.

- Húp 2000+ lượt miễn phí - Vẽ bùa mỏi tay, Tướng 6 sao về ngay!
Nhà phát hành dành tặng người chơi hơn 2000 lượt quay tướng hoàn toàn miễn phí như một lời chào sân đầy thành ý. Ngay khi bước vào thế giới tà khí, bạn đã có thể khai đàn, vẽ bùa và triệu hồi liên tục mà không cần đắn đo tài nguyên. Hàng nghìn cơ hội mở phong ấn, săn tìm Tướng 6 sao đang chờ đón, giúp hành trình trấn áp quỷ thần khởi đầu thuận lợi và bùng nổ ngay từ những phút đầu tiên.

- 6 loại trận đồ - 9 ô chiến thuật - 69 kiểu chơi
Sở hữu 6 loại trận đồ biến hóa, kết hợp cùng 9 ô chiến thuật linh hoạt, người chơi có thể tự do sáng tạo đến 69 kiểu vận hành đội hình khác nhau. Mỗi cách sắp xếp là một thế trận riêng với quy luật khắc chế, mỗi sự thay đổi là một bước xoay chuyển cục diện - nơi tư duy chiến thuật quyết định thắng bại, không chỉ sức mạnh đơn thuần.

- Chưa vào game – Chưa biết thế nào là mãn nhãn.
Đồ họa quỷ thần được khắc họa đầy ám ảnh và choáng ngợp, từ pháp trận rực linh hỏa đến những thực thể hắc hóa phủ đầy tà khí. Mỗi khung hình đều dày đặc hiệu ứng, ánh sáng và chuyển động sống động, tạo nên cảm giác như đang bước vào một thế giới ma mị u ám thực thụ. Chưa đặt chân vào game - chưa thể cảm nhận hết thế nào là mãn nhãn.

- Thí luyện vô hạn tầng - Sai hệ dừng bước - Đúng hệ lên đỉnh.
Leo Tháp Ngũ Hệ Vô Tận là hành trình thí luyện không hồi kết giữa màn sương tà khí dày đặc. Mỗi tầng tháp là một thử thách khắc nghiệt của ngũ hành tương khắc - chọn sai hệ, lập tức dừng bước; chọn đúng hệ, phá ấn mà tiến lên đỉnh cao. Trong không gian u ám và ma lực bủa vây, chỉ những đạo sĩ am hiểu thiên đạo mới đủ sức bước tiếp qua vô hạn tầng tháp.

- Game "chiều" đạo sĩ nhất: Chơi mỗi ngày - tặng ngay VIP 6
Giữa thế giới tà khí u ám, đạo sĩ không đơn độc trên hành trình trấn ấn quỷ thần. Phúc lợi dày đặc trải dài theo từng cấp độ, đặc biệt tặng miễn phí VIP 6 chỉ cần chăm chỉ đăng nhập mỗi ngày. Không cần hiến tế tài nguyên, không cần đổi chác vận may - càng tu luyện, càng được ưu đãi, để pháp lực thăng hoa và quyền năng ngày một lớn mạnh.

data.name: ドラゴンブラッド：スレイヤーズ学院
data.description_full:
累計発行部数3000万部、全世界で爆発的な人気を誇るファンタジー小説「龍族」が群像劇RPGで登場！
AIアシスタント搭載、魅力的なキャラで爽快バトル、新たなIFルートで運命を廻せ！

▼没入感の高いストーリーとIFストーリー
世界中で大人気の原作小説を元に構築した300万文字を超える濃厚なストーリー。
豪華声優陣の熱演によりさまざまな名場面や名台詞を再現。
本作だけのオリジナルIFルートを多数実装し、全キャラとデートも可能に！
原作では描かれなかった未知なる可能性を、あなたの手で体験しよう！

▼今なら最大400連分無料ガチャ！ログインだけで全キャラ解放のチャンス！
キャラクターの収集ハードルは低めに設定！
ログインボーナスでは、恒常・限定を問わず多くのキャラクターが入手可能！
イベント報酬も充実！ 魅力的なキャラを仲間に迎え絆を深めよう！

▼セミオート王道RPG×策略×爽快バトル
キャラクターの編成や絆の発動など、あなたの戦略次第でバトルはより楽しく奥深く変化する！
オートプレイモードもあるので、カジュアルにも楽しめる！
キャラクターごとにバトル中の専用演出もあるので、爽快感UP！
策略を駆使して、言霊を放て！

▼デイリーミッションはAIにお任せ！
ゲーム内にはAI助手“ノルマ”を実装。
ボタンひとつで面倒なデイリーミッションなどをAIがオールクリア。キャラ育成も超簡単。
より快適に、より自由に、ストレスフリーで『ドラガク』を楽しめる！

▼世界を広げる豊富なイベントとコンテンツ
バトルやメインストーリー以外にも、数多くのミニゲームやサブストーリーを実装！
月毎にイベントも実装し、さまざまな角度から『ドラガク』の世界をディープに遊びつくそう！

▼豪華なサウンドと演出
テーマ曲《IVORY TOWER》はさまざまなアニメやドラマのサウンドを手掛ける澤野弘之氏が担当。
さらに美麗なキャラクター、迫力あるCG演出、Live2Dによる繊細な動きが、新たな『龍族』の世界へあなたを導きます！
豪華声優陣が続々出演（五十音順）
石川界人、伊東健人、小倉唯、鬼頭明里、黒沢ともよ、小林裕介、関根瞳、能登麻美子、広瀬裕也、堀江瞬、前野智昭 他（敬称略）

▼ストーリー
遥か昔、この星は【黒の龍王】ニードホッグを創造した。
そして【黒の龍王】は、【白の龍王】をはじめとするすべての竜の始祖となった。
【黒の龍王】は錬金術と言霊で人間たちを支配し、この世界に君臨した。
その後、【黒の龍王】は四大君主と呼ばれる4対の龍王を創造し、【白の龍王】は人間との間に多くの混血種たちを残した。
世界は竜族を中心に廻っているかのように見えたが……
ある日、【黒の龍王】が暗殺されたことで世界は一変した。
これこそが、竜族と人間、そして混血種たちの気の遠くなるほど長い歴史のはじまりだった。
さまざまな思惑が錯綜する世界で、竜の討伐を目的としたカッセル学院を舞台に、新たな運命の輪が廻り始める。

data.name: Aviator Vortex
data.description_full:
**Aviator Vortex** - Defend the universe in this intense cosmic shooter!

Strap into your high-speed red fighter jet and dive into the heart of a massive, swirling cosmic vortex! Alien invaders are pouring out from the wormhole, threatening universal peace. Your mission is clear: circle the vortex, dodge deadly obstacles, and unleash powerful firepower to eliminate wave after wave of enemy UFOs.

**Game Features:**
- ⚡ Epic vortex-based gameplay - Fly in dynamic circular paths around the swirling wormhole
- 👾 Intense space combat - Blast through hordes of alien ships emerging from the portal
- 🌌 Stunning visual effects - Immersive cosmic graphics with glowing vortex, asteroids, and neon energy trails
- 🔥 Smooth controls with responsive rotation and shooting mechanics
- 🏆 High-score challenge - How long can you survive and protect the galaxy?

data.name: Orbital Engagement
data.description_full:

In Orbital Engagement, you are a fleet commander in charge of a planetary network. Launch your units from orbit to capture planets, reinforce your positions, and invade enemy strongholds.

Spawn and deploy three specialized unit classes, each with its own tactical strengths and weaknesses:
• Circles: The versatile vanguard. Balanced speed, production, and capture rates. Strong against Squares, weak to Triangles.
• Triangles: The swift strike force. High speed and rapid production make them perfect for reinforcements, though they capture slower. Strong against Circles, weak to Squares.
• Squares: The heavy dreadnoughts. Slow and costly to house, but possess devastating capturing capabilities. Strong against Triangles, weak to Circles.

🌌 Planet Upgrades & Resource Management
Manage your planetary economy wisely. Invest your units to upgrade your worlds across 5 distinct tiers. Upgraded planets feature higher health pools and production rates, turning them into impregnable fortresses. Will you expand rapidly or build up a cluster of level 5 home bases?

Embark on a galactic campaign spanning 24 unique sectors—from the entry-level Alpha Sector to the chaotic, multi-faction battlegrounds of the Omega Sector. Face off against up to four rival AI factions simultaneously, each with distinct colors and adaptive behaviors.

🤖 Adaptive AI & Multiple Difficulties
Test your strategic limits. The AI adjusts its behaviors based on personalities (Defensive, Balanced, and Aggressive). Choose from Easy, Medium, or Hard difficulty settings to match your skill level and keep the challenge fresh.

🏆 Global Leaderboards & Cloud Sync
Sign in securely via Google or Email to sync your campaign progress across devices. Track your fastest completion times for each sector and compete against commanders worldwide on the global leaderboards. Every second counts!

🕹️ Built for Mobile Comfort
Designed from the ground up for touchscreen play:
• 1-Finger drag to pan and pinch-to-zoom to view the entire sector.

Are you ready to take command, pilot? The galaxy awaits. Download Orbital Engagement today and launch your invasion!

โลกสวนดอกไม้ของฉันเป็นเกมจำลองสถานการณ์ที่ผ่อนคลายและเยียวยาจิตใจ ที่นี่คุณจะได้พบเพื่อนรักดอกไม้มากมาย และสร้างสังคมเพื่อนรักดอกไม้ของคุณเอง

〓 โชคดีมาแล้ว ‧ ดอกไม้สดส่งฟรีถึงบ้าน 〓
ความโรแมนติกสุดพิเศษสำหรับคุณ! เพียงปลูกดอกไม้ในเกม เมื่อเก็บเกี่ยวดอกไม้ที่โตเต็มที่ คุณมีโอกาสได้รับการ์ดอวยพรดอกไม้ และแลกเป็นช่อดอกไม้สดส่งตรงถึงบ้านฟรีเลย!

〓 ปลูกดอกไม้สบายๆ ‧ สร้างสวนเฉพาะของคุณ 〓
ในสวนเฉพาะของคุณ ปลูกดูแลกล้วยไม้ ลีลาวดี ดอกมะลิ และดอกไม้มากมายด้วยมือคุณเอง เพลิดเพลินกับช่วงเวลาการปลูกที่ผ่อนคลายและบำบัดใจ ปล่อยวางความเครียดทีละนิด พร้อมสัมผัสความอบอุ่นจากเพื่อนดอกไม้ที่อยู่เคียงข้าง

〓 สนุกกับเพื่อน ‧ คลายเครียดด้วยสังคมเกม 〓
ในสวนไม่มีคำว่าเหงา! ผูกมิตรกับเพื่อนซี้ เข้าร่วมกิลด์ เยี่ยมชมสวนเพื่อน หรือแม้แต่ "แอบขโมย" ดอกไม้จากเพื่อนได้ด้วย! สัมผัสประสบการณ์การเล่นที่สนุกสนานและผ่อนคลาย ทุกการพบเจอคือความประหลาดใจ

〓 ศิลปะการจัดดอกไม้ ‧ สร้างสรรค์ชีวิตมีระดับ 〓
ดอกไม้ที่เก็บเกี่ยวไม่ได้มีไว้ชมเท่านั้น แต่ยังจัดแต่งได้อย่างอิสระ ผสมผสานแจกันและดอกไม้หลากหลายชนิด สร้างสรรค์ผลงานจัดดอกไม้ของคุณเอง ตั้งแต่เลือกสีสันไปจนถึงสไตล์ ออกแบบสุนทรียภาพที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์เฉพาะตัว

〓 บริหารร้านดอกไม้ ‧ สัมผัสชีวิตเจ้าของร้าน 〓
รับออเดอร์ จัดทำ ขาย ขยายร้านดอกไม้ของคุณทีละขั้นตอน สร้างร้านดอกไม้ยอดนิยมของคุณอย่างค่อยเป็นค่อยไป ใช้กลยุทธ์การบริหารเพื่อเพิ่มรายได้ ให้สวนและร้านค้าเติบโตไปพร้อมกัน

〓 สัตว์เลี้ยงแสนน่ารัก ‧ เยียวยาใจเป็นสองเท่า 〓
ดูแลน้องแมวน่ารักในบ้านแมว ให้อาหาร ลูบไล้ ตกแต่งพื้นที่ส่วนตัว เพลิดเพลินกับช่วงเวลาแห่งความอบอุ่นที่มีเพื่อนซี้สี่ขาอยู่เคียงข้าง!

Can You Crack the Case?

Every crime scene has a solution. Every clue has a purpose. It’s up to you to piece everything together.

Put your detective instincts to the test, solve clever grid puzzles, and uncover the truth behind each mystery. Download today and see how many cases you can crack.

data.name: Five Nights at Freddy's House
data.description_full: Welcome to your thrilling new night shift at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza — a place where laughter, music, and the smell of fresh pizza fill the air all day long! The star of the show is the one and only Freddy Fazbear, joined by his two beloved companions. Together, they are state-of-the-art animatronic performers, built to dazzle and delight every guest who walks through the doors! But once the lights dim and the crowds go home, these machines take on a life of their own — and nobody quite knows why. Fixing them? Too expensive. Hiring you as the overnight security guard? Much more budget-friendly, apparently. Tucked inside your tiny office, your only weapons are the surveillance monitors and your own nerves. But here's the catch — your power supply for the entire night is strictly limited, thanks to some creative corporate accounting. The moment that electricity runs dry, the doors won't lock and the lights won't switch on. So keep your eyes sharp — if Freddy or his friends have wandered away from where they should be, track them down fast and do whatever it takes to stay safe! Think you have what it takes to make it through five nights at Freddy's?

data.name: Spades Ace
data.description_full: Spades Ace is a timeless and widely loved trick-taking card game tailored for four players, who form two opposite sitting teams and compete cooperatively. Using a standard 52-card deck, the game follows a core fixed rule: spades serve as the permanent trump suit that beats all other suits in every round. Each round starts with blind bidding, where every player predicts their number of winning tricks, and the sum of teammates’ bids forms the compulsory team contract. During gameplay, participants play cards in clockwise order and must follow the lead suit if possible; players may play any card or trump with spades to seize the trick when they have no matching suit. Iconic mechanics such as high-reward Nil bids and cumulative bag penalties bring rich strategic layers, requiring players to flexibly switch between bold offense and steady defense. Teams gain points for successful contract completion and suffer point deductions for failed bids or excessive overtricks. Perfectly combining teamwork, logical judgment and tactical gameplay, Spades Ace is suitable for casual social entertainment and competitive matches, where the first team to hit 500 points wins the game.
data.description_short: A classic 4-player team trick-taking card game.

data.name: Crowd Bus Jam
data.description_full:
🚌 Match the Passengers, Fill the Buses! 🚌

Your mission: get every waiting passenger onto the right bus. Sounds simple? Wait until you see the crowd. The platform can hold up to 64 passengers at once — and they keep coming in batches of 12.

🎨 Match by Color
Each passenger has a color. Each bus also has a color. A red passenger can only board a red bus. No exceptions. You’ll need to keep an eye on the platform and match colors carefully.

🚍 8 Seats per Bus
Every bus fits exactly 8 passengers. That means you can’t just throw random people on board. You have to fill each bus completely with the right color before it leaves.

🧠 Plan Your Platform
Passengers arrive in batches of 12. If you don’t match them quickly, the platform fills up. Once it hits 64, no more passengers can arrive — and if there’s no space for the next batch… game over. You’ll need to balance which buses to call and which colors to prioritize.

🌈 More Colors, More Chaos
As you level up, more colors appear. Passengers come in trickier patterns. The platform gets crowded fast. You’ll need quick decisions and a sharp memory to keep everything moving.

🏆 Can You Clear the Platform?
The goal is simple: get every passenger on a bus before the platform overflows. No timer, but every batch adds pressure. One wrong bus choice and you might block yourself for good.

Ready to become the ultimate dispatch master? Match those colors, fill those buses, and clear the queue! 🚦🔴🔵🟡🟢🚌

data.name: Merge Parade
data.description_full:
■ Build Your Army on a 5×5 Grid.

Merge Parade is a formation-based auto-battler set on a 5×5 grid. Buy monsters, merge them into stronger evolutions, and arrange them in a winning layout using powerful adjacency passives. Combat plays out automatically — your only job is deciding who stands where. One smart placement can turn the tide.

■ Core Gameplay Loop

- Buy monsters from the shop
- Place them on your 5×5 grid
- Merge neighboring units to evolve them
- Watch the auto-battle play out
- Use the gold you earn to build an even stronger army for the next fight

Battles end fast — about a minute at normal speed, just 20 seconds at top speed. Perfect for a quick session, addictive enough to lose hours in.

■ From a Tiny Slime to a Mighty Dragon

Goblins, slimes, plants, undead, demons, elementals, dragons, constructs, beasts — nine cute monster tribes to recruit and combine. Follow recipes to merge them, and watch small units evolve into towering powerhouses. Chain a few humble slimes all the way up to a colossal dragon lord and feel the army truly grow.

■ Formation Is Everything

Every unit comes with passives that depend on where you place it: "boost the attack of adjacent allies," "shine alone in a corner," "weaken nearby enemies," and many more. Columns also build up stacks of burn, slow, and shield as the fight unfolds. Push a stack high enough and a Surge erupts — a powerful burst that can flip the whole battle.

Stacking strong units isn't enough. Who stands next to whom, and which column they hold, decides the fight.

■ One Run, Fifteen Battles. Try Again, Try Smarter.

A roguelite structure with lives. Beat all 15 battles to clear a run. Lose a fight but keep your lives, and you can retry. Lose your last life, and the run ends.

Even a defeat teaches you something — new unit knowledge, new recipes discovered, new matchups understood. Every run sharpens your strategy for the next. Once you've conquered the basics, take on the tougher difficulty modes waiting for you. If you've got the skill, the challenge is ready.

■ A Small Goblin with Big Dreams

Meet Gobsby — a small-town goblin with grand ambitions. Beside him is Nick, a chatty little mimic-book, narrating his journey. With only a handful of monster friends at his side, Gobsby sets out for the distant Demon Lord's castle.

Recruit allies. Crush rivals. Watch your tiny gang grow into a marching army — a long, eccentric parade across the world. Cute, a little clumsy, but impossible not to root for. Their story is waiting for you to play it.

■ Perfect For Players Who Love

- Auto-battlers and idle-style action
- Puzzle-strategy and tactical placement
- Collecting, merging, and leveling up
- Quick sessions that fit any pocket of time
- Charming monster designs

■ Free to Play

* Optional in-app purchases / Contains ads

Take command. Set your formation. March your army to victory.

data.name: Color Match: Block Jam Puzzle
data.description_full:
Welcome to Color Match: Block Jam Puzzle—the most challenging and strategic color sorting puzzle game!

In this colorful 3D world, the blocks are jammed together! Your mission is to use clever strategies to sort these messy blocks and guide them to their matching color collectors. This will test not only your observation skills but also your ultimate logic and spatial planning!

✨ How to Play:

Tap to Guide: Observe the block layout and tap the unblocked outer color blocks to move them down to the waiting queue.

Match Precisely: When the block's color in the queue matches the currently open collector, they will be successfully collected!

Beware of Jams: The slots in the waiting queue are limited! If you tap too many unmatched blocks and the queue fills up, it's game over. Think before you tap!

Untangle the Puzzle: Carefully observe the overlapping layers of the blocks. Clear the outer blocks first to make a path for the crucial colors hidden inside!

🌟 Game Features:

Brand New Puzzle Experience: Say goodbye to traditional match-3! This innovative gameplay combines spatial puzzles, color sorting, and jam mechanics to give your brain a real workout.

Tons of Levels: From simple beginner stages to mind-bending, complex 3D block mazes, hundreds of well-designed levels are waiting for you to conquer.

Relaxing & Addictive: Minimalist and cozy 3D graphics, smooth animations, and satisfying sound effects. Every time you clear the board, you'll feel a huge sense of accomplishment.

Powerful Boosters: Stuck on a tricky level? Don't panic! Use powerful boosters like the Freeze, Hammer, or Magnet to help you break the deadlock and win the game.

Say goodbye to mindless tapping and use your wisdom to solve this colorful block jam! Download Color Match: Block Jam Puzzle now and see how many levels you can clear!

Pixel Bead ASMR: Sort, Place & Create Satisfying Bead Art

Step into a cozy, tactile world where every tap turns into a tiny click of color. Pixel Bead ASMR blends the calming joy of bead crafting with smooth color-sorting puzzles and satisfying ASMR sound design. Sort shining beads, place them into the board, and watch beautiful pixel art slowly come to life — all at your own peaceful pace.

Whether you want a quick relaxing break or a longer creative session, Pixel Bead ASMR is designed to be easy to start, hard to put down, and deeply soothing from the very first tap.

How to Play: Sort Beads, Build Pixel Art, Relax

Tap to Sort by Color: Pick up a stack of matching beads and place them onto the board. No complicated rules — just calm, intuitive sorting.
Plan Your Bead Tray: Keep your side tray tidy. Thinking one step ahead makes each puzzle flow smoother and feels extra satisfying.
Reveal Hidden Pixel Art: As you sort and place beads, a hidden pixel art image slowly appears, piece by piece.
Play at Your Own Pace: No timers, no pressure. Just gentle, rewarding gameplay that fits any mood.
What Makes Pixel Bead ASMR Special

True ASMR Audio: Every click, slide and drop is carefully crafted with crisp, high-quality sounds. Wear headphones for the ultimate tingly relaxation.
Beautiful Bead Aesthetics: Soft lighting, gentle shadows and realistic bead textures give every level a warm, handcrafted feel.
Hundreds of Pixel Art Levels: Animals, food, flowers, seasonal themes and surprise collections — new artwork added regularly.
Smart Sort Assist: Same-color beads auto-cluster in your tray, so you can focus on creating, not micromanaging.
Play Offline, Anywhere: No Wi-Fi, no ads interrupting focus moments. Pause anytime and pick up right where you left off.
Why You’ll Love Pixel Bead ASMR

Gentle Stress Relief: Rhythmic sorting and soothing sounds help calm a busy mind — perfect for winding down after work or before sleep.
Light Brain Workout: Color matching, spatial planning and tray management keep your mind softly engaged without ever feeling stressful.
For Everyone: Kids, adults, casual players and pixel art fans all fit right in. Easy to learn, endlessly enjoyable.
A Creative Hobby in Your Pocket: Turn small moments — a coffee break, a commute, a quiet evening — into tiny works of pixel bead art.
Put on your headphones, tap a bead, and let the soft clicks take you somewhere calm.
Download Pixel Bead ASMR today and start building your own pixel bead world — one satisfying bead at a time.
data.description_short: Tap, sort & place beads. Reveal pixel art. Pure ASMR relaxation

data.name: Dominos Air Aviator
data.description_full:
Welcome to Dominos Air Aviator, a domino chain game set in an aviation-themed world where four pilots compete in a relaxed, strategic match.

In each round, four pilots take turns playing. Every player starts with 7 domino tiles. On each turn, a tile can be placed only if one side matches the number at either open end of the domino chain on the table.

If a player has no valid move, they must pass the turn and wait for the next round.

The game continues as players build the domino chain step by step, making careful decisions and managing their tiles strategically.
data.description_short: Four pilots play a turn-based domino chain matching game.

data.name: Tabuu - Word Party Game
data.description_full:
Taboo is a fast and fun word party game you can play with friends. Build your teams, choose the next clue giver, describe the main word on the card, and try to help your team guess it without using the forbidden words.

Each round is played against the clock. Correct answers earn points, taboo mistakes cost points, and pass rights are limited. Think fast, give creative clues, and help your team take the lead.

Features:

• Create teams and customize team colors
• Adjust round time, round count, and pass limit
• Play with different word categories
• Expand your vocabulary and test your skills in multiple languages! Enjoy dedicated card packs in English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, and Serbian. 🇬🇧 🇹🇷 🇩🇪 🇫🇷 🇪🇸 🇮🇹 🇵🇹 🇷🇸
• Fast countdown and round start screens
• Round result and score summary
• Simple party game flow for groups of friends
• Offline play support

How to play:

1. Create at least two teams.
2. The clue giver describes the main word on the card.
3. Help your teammates guess the word without saying the forbidden words.
4. Correct answers earn points.
5. Taboo mistakes reduce your score.
6. Solve as many cards as possible before time runs out.

Taboo is designed for game nights, friend groups, and anyone who enjoys word guessing games. With simple rules, quick rounds, and team-based competition, everyone can join the fun in seconds.

Describe the word, avoid the taboo clues, and grab the point with your team.
